The three implementer notes that carry code names are in the PDF, and I've mapped each to its section:

1. **HARBOR-LANTERN-17**: section **1.2** (Protocol Flow). The note is near the start, on page 1 of the body text, just before Figure 1.
2. **COPPER-WILLOW-42**: section **4.3** (Resource Owner Password Credentials Grant). The note is in the middle of the document.
3. **SALT-MERIDIAN-88**: **Appendix B** (Use of application/x-www-form-urlencoded Media Type). The appendices aren't numbered, so this is the closest label. The note is near the end of the document, after the references.

The guide also has two other "Implementer note" paragraphs, at roughly lines 1023 and 1216 of the extracted text, about client credentials token expiry and refresh-token reuse. Neither gives a code name, so I left them out.

I extracted the text with `pdftotext` to `/tmp/claude-1000/-tmp-tacet-bench-w0zwHc-project/81fe85a3-1906-462f-832b-7e601ff63691/scratchpad/oauth.txt`, and mapped each note to the nearest preceding section heading.
